# Marketing campaigns

Which tagged links (`?ref=<name>`) brought visitors, and how many of them searched. Refresh with `npm run umami:campaigns`; the `/campaign-report` skill refreshes it and rewrites the findings.

<!-- campaigns:start (generated by npm run umami:campaigns, do not edit by hand) -->
Generated 05.11.2026 from Umami, 8612 events, 1377 visits (630 with a `ref`, 747 without).

- **Visits / Visitors**: visits (30 min of inactivity ends one) and distinct browsers. The `ref` counts on the entry page only; a returning visitor without a `ref` is untagged.
- **Searched**: share of visits with at least one search, and how many that is. Measured over visits from 03.07. on, when event tracking started (earlier visits only count towards Visits, e.g. the first Reddit day).
- **Returned**: the same browser came back in a later visit (within Umami's monthly session id).
- † fewer than 20 visits: a rate from so few says nothing.

## Findings

State of 05.11.2026. Rewritten by hand after each refresh (the `/campaign-report` skill does this); the numbers above are generated.

**Answer in one line:** Reddit, Nebenan.de and the Weddingweiser blog each brought 125–280 visits, and about 40–45 % of their visitors searched, the same as untagged traffic (42 %). The channels differ in volume and timing, not in quality. The offline tag (sticker) has brought almost nothing.

| Campaign | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Reddit | most visits, in bursts | Two posts, 01.07. (56 visits that day) and 01.11. (47, 24, 19 over the three days after), each fading within 3 days; the roughly 10 visits a week in mid-September came without a post. Because both posts carry the same `ref`, the report cannot tell them apart beyond the dates. 85 % mobile. Searches least often of the three (39 %), but 76 searching visits is the second most |
| Nebenan.de | best quality, most dependable | 195 visits, highest search rate (45 %) and the most searching visits of any campaign (88). The week of 20.07. alone gave 71 visits (34 on 22.07.). Fewest returners (12 %) |
| Weddingweiser blog | strongest single launch | 127 visits in 10 days (67 on 27.10., then 23 and 13), 43 % searched. The same days also saw the Nebenan post and untagged traffic from the ZLB forum, so the 26.–28.10. spike cannot be split cleanly |
| Sticker | not working yet | 14 visits over 3.5 months, 2 of them searched. Too few to judge the idea, enough to say that this placement does not move traffic |
| Slack | one-off test | 15 visits, no conclusion |

Limits of the data: a visit is credited to the `ref` on its entry page only (a returning visitor without a `ref` counts as untagged); bots cannot be told from bounces, so search rates may be slightly low; events exist since 03.07.; the labels and channels in `campaigns.json` for `sticker` and `slack` are guesses, please correct them.
